web-pubsub-premium-for-zone-resilience.title: Web PubSub tier below Premium is not zone resilient
web-pubsub-premium-for-zone-resilience.body: This production workload needs to keep running if one datacenter fails, but it is priced on a tier below Premium. Microsoft says the Premium tier is the one that is resilient to availability zone failures and supports geo-replication. Price the Premium tier instead, or confirm that a datacenter failure can be tolerated.

citation.source: Reliability in Azure Web PubSub Service
citation.quote: The premium tier is resilient to availability zone failures in supported regions, and enables you to configure geo-replication.
